blockers.title: Live Container Integration Execution
blockers.description: 17 integration tests covering live PostgreSQL 16 pgvector operations, schema migrations, and Qdrant collection isolation were withheld due to host available physical RAM constraint (467.7 MB – 1,057.8 MB < 2048 MB threshold).
blockers.closure_action: Execute docker compose integration commands on a runner with >= 2048 MB free RAM prior to pushing to Render.

blockers.title: Paired Storage Volume Snapshotting for Raw Uploads
blockers.description: PostgreSQL backups restore document metadata and extracted text, but raw uploaded PDF/DOCX binaries in STORAGE_PATH or S3 bucket must be snapshotted concurrently.
blockers.closure_action: Configure storage volume snapshot or S3 bucket versioning/replication in staging environment setup.
